{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsor fin''' was part of a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike. During their race through the crystal swamps of [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] pulled up into [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] repulsor fin, resulting in a crash that severely injured Dengar.
